All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
AbstractRulesEngine<O>
The AbstractRulesEngine is an abstract implementation of the RulesEngine interface.
ActionContext
What an action runs against: the run's facts and the output object.
CompileContext
What every compilation of a rule list is given: the imports registered with RulesEngine.addImports(Set) before RulesEngine.setRuleList(java.util.List), and the class loader to look classes up with.
CompiledAction
A compiled action.
CompiledCondition
A compiled condition.
EvaluationContext
What a condition is evaluated against.
ExpressionCompiler
Compiles the conditions and actions of one rule list, and checks the names of the facts they run against.
ExpressionLanguage
A language that rule conditions and actions are written in, such as MVEL.
Fact<T>
A Fact is an implementation of FactReference.
FactMap<T>
FactMap is an implementation of FactStore.
FactReference<T>
A FactReference refers to objects that are used by the rules engine in conditional statements.
FactStore<T>
FactStore is an extension of a Map.
InvalidExpressionException
Thrown by an ExpressionCompiler to reject an expression that breaks a rule the engine enforces, such as a condition that assigns to a fact.
LoggingRuleListener
An out-of-the-box RuleListener that logs lifecycle events via SLF4J at the DEBUG level.
MvelExpressionLanguage
MVEL 2, the engine's default expression language.
Rule
A Rule is an object that guides the RulesEngine.
Rule.RuleBuilder
 
RuleCompilationException
Exception thrown when a rule fails to compile.
RuleExecutionException
Exception thrown when a rule fails to execute (either condition or action).
RuleListener
A listener interface to hook into the lifecycle of rule evaluation and execution.
RulesEngine<O>
The RulesEngine fires the action expression from a list of Rule objects when their conditions evaluate to true.
RulesEngineBuilder
A builder to construct instances of RulesEngine.
StatefulRulesEngine<O>
A StatefulRulesEngine is a concrete implementation that extends the AbstractRulesEngine class.
StatelessRulesEngine<O>
A StatelessRulesEngine is a concrete implementation that extends the AbstractRulesEngine class.
UnrulyException
The base runtime exception for the Unruly engine.
